thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/29/2018: YNDX, NXPI, TSEM

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/29/2018: YNDX, NXPI, TSEM
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.5%
AAPL: +1.5
IBM: -3.8%
CSCO: +1.5%
GOOG: +1.3%
Technology stocks were mostly higher in pre-market trading Monday.
Among the stocks moving on news:
(+) Yandex ( YNDX ) rose more than 6% after reporting Q3 adjusted earnings that rose year-over-year and revenue that topped analysts' forecasts; it also revised its revenue guidance for fiscal 2018.
In other sector news:
(+) NXP Semiconductors NV ( NXPI ) gained 4% after Nasdaq said the company is set to become a component of the NASDAQ-100 Index, the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index, and the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector Index prior to market open on Monday, Nov. 5.
(-) Tower Semiconductor ( TSEM ) fell nearly 16% after reporting lower-than-expected results for Q3, while providing upbeat outlook for Q4 revenue.
